snippet.title: Journey to the Void - Gameplay Demo Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
With hero abilities, rich moral choices, and elemental biomes, Journey to the Void isn’t just another roguelite deckbuilder - and you can now enjoy a playable demo via Steam to see for yourself.

Ahead of the game’s full release later this summer, developer RuneHeads’ is presenting its fun twist on the genre, including playable characters with nerf and buff traits, unlockable cards exclusive to certain in-game regions, and more than 100 narrative decisions to make.
